name: Osananajimi wa Stalker?
source:
Akari loves Youta, her childhood friend!
She knows everything about him. Of course that includes his sexual interests!
To make her beloved "boyfriend" happy Akari breaks into his house to satisfy him......
It's the arrival of a crazy little stalker baka-ero adventure game!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ102202.html]DLsite English[/url]]
